newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Infratil says forming new company.
newsitem.headline: Infratil says forming new company.

text.p: Infrastructure and Utilities New Zealand Limited announced on Wednesday that discussions were currently being held which, if finalised, could lead to a pro rata renounceable entitlement offer to shareholders in respect of a new company currently being formed, Infratil International Limited.

"Infratil International Ltd would use issue proceeds to facilitate specialist long term investments in infrastructure and utility assets world-wide," Infrastrusture and Utilities Ltd (Infratil NZ) said.
"Infratil International would look to investment in countries other than New Zealand and Australia.

"As Infratil NZ's investment focus is on New Zealand-based assets, it would not invest in the new company, but it would provide Infratil International with access to its share register to enable an entitlements offer by Infratil International to be made to shareholders of Infratil NZ."
A key determinant of whether the offer proceeds would be successful conclusion of current negotiations concerning a proposed initial investment by Infratil International.
Shareholders would be told by early June if the new offering would take place.

The new company would be managed by Morrison & Co, a specialist adviser to the infrastructure and utilities sector which presently manages Infratil NZ and Infratil Australia Ltd, a public unlisted company Morrison & Co said would seek to list on the Australian Stock Exchange during 1997.
